'''April 2000 Williston Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Williston Park, NY on 15 April 2000. [[Scott Lingrell]] won it. It is known from Brad Vogel's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d527">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-15-williston-park-new-york-4-15-00d527/ williston-park-new-york-4-15-00], DeckTech (Brad "Uncle Chall" Vogel, 15 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-15-williston-park-new-york-4-15-00d527/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Williston Park, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 22
* '''Winner:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]
